records.title: Completion of full subsidiary acquisition of Bitbank, Inc.
records.summary: SBI Holdings announced completion of the acquisition making Bitbank a wholly owned subsidiary on Oct 1, 2026.
records.limitations: Does not itself disclose consolidated post-close XRP customer balances, reserve addresses or market share.

records.title: Basic agreement and share-transfer agreement for full acquisition of Bitbank
records.summary: SBI's June 25 announcement presented combined pre-close figures for SBI VC Trade and Bitbank based on Apr 30 data: approximately JPY 1.1T in assets under custody and 2.92M accounts.
records.methodology: Official SBI Holdings acquisition announcement and its stated April 30 comparison date.
records.limitations: These are pre-close combined figures, not a post-close audited balance sheet or XRP-specific custody total.

records.title: Bitbank exchange order guide — XRP/JPY market
records.summary: Bitbank's official exchange guide lists XRP/JPY among its spot order-book markets.
records.limitations: Market availability does not establish current order-book depth, volume, customer holdings or SBI group-wide custody.

records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / Aplus / Visa
records.title: SBI VISA Crypto Card — BTC, ETH or XRP rewards
records.summary: The cardholder selects one of BTC, ETH or XRP at application; points are automatically converted monthly into the selected crypto without exchange fees, with an SBI VC Trade account required. The launch campaign advertised temporary higher reward rates.
records.methodology: Official SBI Group announcement with card terms and conversion mechanics.
records.limitations: The announcement does not disclose XRP reward volume, inventory sourcing, hedging, or whether rewards create net spot-market purchases.

records.publisher: SBI Holdings / SBI VC Trade / Orient Corporation
records.title: Orico Points can be exchanged for BTC, ETH or XRP
records.summary: From July 31, 2026, 1,200 Orico points can be exchanged for JPY 1,000 worth of BTC, ETH or XRP, credited to the customer's SBI VC Trade account; the conversion rate uses the following month's VCTRADE selling price.
records.methodology: Official SBI Group announcement with point conversion and settlement terms.
records.limitations: Redemption volumes, XRP sourcing, hedging and net spot-market impact are not disclosed.

records.publisher: SBI Shinsei Bank / SBI VC Trade
records.title: Yen time-deposit campaign with XRP exchange vouchers
records.summary: A six-month yen time-deposit campaign offered XRP exchange vouchers up to JPY 20,000 for qualifying deposits and registration. This is a historical campaign, not evidence of a continuing offer.
records.limitations: Campaign period and actual redemption totals are not established in this source; no aggregate XRP purchase figure is disclosed.

records.title: Ripple and SBI Group partner to launch RLUSD in Japan
records.summary: Ripple announced JFSA approval and official RLUSD launch in Japan under the Payment Services Act as a new electronic payment instrument, offered to institutional and retail users through SBI VC Trade. Ripple described use cases in payments, tokenization and collateral management.
records.methodology: Official Ripple press release quoting Ripple and SBI VC Trade executives.
records.limitations: Issuer statement confirms launch and intended use cases, not realized settlement volumes, collateral balances or net capital flows.

records.title: September 2026 custody-balance growth ranking: RLUSD, JPYSC, TON
records.summary: SBI VC Trade reported September 2026 custody-balance growth ranking: RLUSD first, JPYSC second, TON third.
records.methodology: Official SBI VC Trade ranking page, published Oct 27.
records.limitations: Ranking is growth rate, not absolute balance, market share or net inflow. USDC not appearing in the top three does not establish USDC decline.

records.title: Proof of concept for tokenized deposits and deposit-based digital money using existing financial infrastructure
records.summary: SBI Ripple Asia described a conceptual proof of concept for low-cost tokenized deposits and deposit-based digital money using SBI's MoneyTap and a token issuance platform, with XRPL considered as the blockchain infrastructure.
records.limitations: Conceptual proof of concept is not production deployment; no transaction volumes, XRP balances or incremental XRP demand were quantified.

records.title: 2026 amendments to Japan's FIEA and Payment Services Act — cryptoasset regulation
records.summary: Legal analysis of Law No.64/2026: passed July 15 and promulgated July 23, core crypto provisions to commence within one year; shifts cryptoasset trading business into FIEA, adds exchange/issuer disclosures, insider-trading and tipping prohibitions for exchange-handled assets, market-manipulation and stealth-marketing rules, and regulation of custody-system providers and reserve requirements.
records.methodology: Detailed Japanese legal analysis by lawyers with prior FSA policy experience, cross-referencing amended statutory provisions.
records.limitations: Exact commencement date and Cabinet Office Ordinance details remain pending; legal analysis is secondary to the statute and implementing orders.

records.title: Facts and fiction: debunking XRP Ledger issuance misconceptions
records.summary: Ripple states 100 billion XRP were created at XRPL inception and no additional XRP has ever been added; the consensus protocol does not allow a single authority to create more XRP.
records.methodology: Official Ripple technical explanation of genesis supply and XRPL consensus.
records.limitations: Issuer statement; use XRPL code/protocol evidence as independent corroboration. Does not by itself determine Japanese legal classification.

records.title: XRP/JPY leverage trading support week and spread campaign
records.summary: SBI VC Trade promoted XRP/JPY leverage trading with a temporary 0.5 JPY standard spread from June 22 through July 3, 2026; the campaign period has ended.
records.methodology: Official SBI Group/SBI VC Trade product announcement.
records.limitations: Historical promotional spread is not a current quote or proof of ongoing market depth, volume or institutional positioning.
